# The Surgery Center at Plano Dermatology

> An independent, exclusively surgical dermatology practice in Plano, Texas.
> Three board-certified, fellowship-trained Mohs surgeons — Dr. Gunjan Modi,
> Dr. Michael Wells, and Dr. Edward Parry — treating skin cancer with Mohs
> micrographic surgery, with an on-site laboratory.

Key facts (all stated on the pages linked below):

- Location: 6100 Windhaven Parkway, Plano, TX 75093. Phone: (972) 378-0620.
  Fax: (972) 378-0630. Text: (469) 945-4414. Hours: Mon-Thu 7:30am-4pm,
  Fri 10am-2pm.
- Differentiator: same-day Mohs surgery for melanoma with MART-1 and SOX10
  immunohistochemical stains run in the practice's own laboratory — removal,
  100% margin assessment, and reconstruction in one visit (not multi-day
  "slow Mohs"). Few practices in North Texas offer this.
- Immunostaining (AE1/AE3) is also available for select high-risk
  non-melanoma tumors such as high-risk squamous cell carcinoma and
  extramammary Paget's disease.
- The practice performs the Bascom cleft lift for pilonidal disease —
  95-97% success in large published series; self-referred patients welcome.
- Mohs cure rates up to 99% for previously untreated skin cancers; most
  tumors clear in one to two stages; referred patients are typically seen
  within days of referral; every referred patient returns to the referring
  physician's care.
- Serving Collin County, the US-75 corridor through Grayson County, Denton
  and Cooke Counties, and southern Oklahoma.
